51. The Mechanic's Metal Shack: ''A curved-roof metal shack with wire fencing surrounding it. Inside is a safe (1), an Armor Workbench, and junk to scavenge."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in [[the Mire]] region of [[Appalachia]]. It is situated west of [[Big B's Rest Stop]] and south of the [[Sunday Brothers' cabin]]. ==Layout== This metal shack with a rounded roof can be found near the river just off of [[Fallout 76 roadways#Route 108|Route 108]]. It is surrounded by chainlink-fencing, with an opening at the front of the shack. The exterior of the shack has some items of interest at the back, including a lootable dumpster, an inaccessible bumper car and crates, a large semi-trailer truck, as well as a fallen [[strangler vine]] tree one can jump over the fence with. The shack is populated with [[tick]]s. Inside of the shack, there are various [[Fallout 76 junk items|junk items]] and containers that can be looted. There is an [[Armor workbench (Fallout 76)|armor workbench]] to the left after entering. There is a bedroom with a [[Bed (Fallout 76)|bed]] that can be slept in, in addition to a [[Safe (Fallout 76)|safe]] ([[Picklock]] 2). There is also a metal box being used as a table, and a cabinet that can be searched. A non-functioning television and a white church pew that can be sat in make up the rest of the bedroom. On the southern side of the shack, behind the metal fence walls, are some assorted machinery and [[circuits]]. ==Notable loot== * [[Mini nuke (Fallout 76)|Mini nuke]] - On top of the locker, a guaranteed spawn. * [[Fusion core (Fallout 76)|Fusion core]] - Inside the locker, a guaranteed spawn. ==Related quest== * [[Stings and Things|Repeatable: Stings and Things]] - The mechanic's metal shack will be marked on the world map as a potential source of a [[tick blood sac]]. ==Appearances== The mechanic's metal shack appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== FO76 Mechanic's metal shack 02.png|Back of the shack FO76 Mechanic's metal shack 03.png|Interior FO76 Mechanic's metal shack 04.png|Bedroom FO76 Mechanic's metal shack 05.png|Machinery ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 unmarked locations]] [[Category:The Mire locations]] [[ru:Металлическая лачуга механика]]

[[Always Vigilant]] |terminal =[[Relay tower LW-B1-22 terminal entries]] |cell name =RelayTower04Ext |refid ={{ID|00261548}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMountain}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeOutdoors}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} * {{Location keyword FO76|ChallengeLocTypeRelayStation}} |edid =LocMountainsRelayTower04Location }} '''Relay tower LW-B1-22''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Savage Divide]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Layout== Located south of [[Sons of Dane compound]] and east of [[Fort Atlas|ATLAS Observatory]], this one-room relay tower is similar to the other relay towers in Appalachia. Central to the room is a pillar with a relay tower terminal on the south side. The southwestern facing entrance is flanked by an [[Automated turret (Fallout 76)|automated wall turret]] on each side. Inside the southwestern facing entrance is a wall-mounted med-kit that typically contains [[Dirty water (Fallout 76)|water]] in some form. The southeastern side of the exterior has a staircase leading to the roof, where a [[Super mutant (Fallout 76)|super mutant]] sentry typically will alert the other occupants of your approach. The entrance on the northeastern wall is flanked by an automated wall turret on the west side of the door, typically of the machine gun variety. ==Notable loot== * [[Heating coil (Fallout 76)|Heating coil]] - Quest item, inside a toolbox on a wooden crate. * Potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] - On the northwest interior wall, inside a locker. * Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] - On the top of the mainframe computer bank, near the lamp, on the computer attached to the large concrete central pillar; northwest if looking at the middle pillar (southeast side of the room). * [[Fusion core (Fallout 76)|Fusion core]] - To the left of the relay tower terminal on a shelf. ==Related quest== * [[Request Government Air Drop]] - A [[US government supply requisition]] holotape can be used in the relay tower terminal. * [[Always Vigilant]] - Defend Rover while he conducts repairs to the relay tower. *[[Strange Bedfellows]] - Upload the "Hook Up" holotape into the terminal. ==Appearances== Relay tower LW-B1-22 appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== Relay Tower LW-B1-22_01.png|Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] location F76 Relay Tower LW-B1-22.png {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Savage Divide locations]] [[ru:Релейная вышка LW-B1-22]] [[zh:轉送塔LW-B1-22]]
